name: np-campaign-emperor
_comment: ARM 1 of the played campaign owed since row PT (NAPOLEON_SPEC §14.1 Q9). France/1805 with the Emperor in the field: he leaves the Seat, joins the concentration on Swabia, fights under his own hand, and the court reacts. Deliberately staged to reach the seven 'fixed but never played' checks — the muster note both ways (T7 fortified / T8 marching), a cavalry charge out of his own province (T9), the Shadow over a marshal who never leaves his side (Ney, T5-T12 -> the Petition for Independent Command), and an emperor-led deep push whose defeats should dim the aura. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).

12: endow Ney with the Duchy of Swabia
